properties.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 10 at 8:15PM CDT until September 10 at 8:30PM CDT by NWS Lubbock TX
properties.description:
At 815 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 5 miles southeast of
Claytonville, or 13 miles northeast of Plainview, moving south at 20
mph.

HAZARD...Golf ball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect wind
damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

This severe thunderstorm will remain over mainly rural areas of
northwestern Floyd, northeastern Hale, southeastern Swisher and
southwestern Briscoe Counties.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.
properties.area: Briscoe, TX; Floyd, TX; Hale, TX; Swisher, TX

properties.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 10 at 8:12PM CDT until September 10 at 8:45PM CDT by NWS Paducah KY
properties.description:
At 812 PM CDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line from
over Milltown to 6 miles east of Gatewood, or along a line from 11
miles west of Poplar Bluff to 10 miles southwest of Doniphan, moving
east at 25 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Doniphan, Budapest, Gatewood, Fairdealing and Briar.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. These storms are capable of producing damaging winds and
large hail.

Continuous cloud to ground lightning is occurring with these storms.
Lightning is one of nature's leading killers. Remember, if you can
hear thunder, you are close enough to be struck by lightning.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with these storms and may lead
to flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded
roadways.

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued September 10 at 8:58PM EDT by NWS Charleston WV
properties.description:
A cluster of heavy showers producing rainfall rates of 1 to 2 inches
per hour will continue to shift slowly to the east southeast this
evening.

Coolville, Rutland, Forked Run State Park, Ravenswood, New Haven,
Mason, Sandyville, Mineralwells, Washington, Tuppers Plains, Lubeck,
Middleport, Chester, and Syracuse.

Interstate 77 in West Virginia between mile markers 144 and 177.
Route 50 in West Virginia between mile markers 1 and 18.

properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Lake Charles has issued a Flood
Warning for the following rivers in Texas...

Pine Island Bayou Near Sour Lake affecting Hardin and Jefferson
Counties.

For the Pine Island Bayou...including Sour Lake...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Pine Island Bayou near Sour Lake.

* WHEN...From this afternoon to Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...At 25.0 feet, Water inundates roads in lowland areas near
the river. Low spots on Old Sour Lake Road are under water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 2:45 PM CDT Thursday the stage was 25.0 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 22.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 2:45 PM CDT Thursday was 25.2 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage this
evening and continue falling to 18.9 feet early Tuesday
afternoon.
- Flood stage is 25.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 25.0
feet on 10/29/1975.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.title: Flood Warning issued September 10 at 10:17AM EDT until September 13 at 2:00AM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Florida...

Alafia River At Lithia affecting Hillsborough County.

Horse Creek Near Arcadia at SR 72 affecting DeSoto County.

...The Flood Warning is cancelled for the following rivers in
Florida...

Little Manatee River At Wimauma at US 301 affecting Hillsborough
County.

Manatee River Near Myakka Head at SR 64 affecting Manatee County.

.Rising water levels are expected over the next several days along
the Alafia River At Lithia and Horse Creek Near Arcadia at SR 72 due
to recent heavy rainfall. The Little Manatee River At Wimauma at US
301 and Manatee River Near Myakka Head at SR 64 are no longer
forecast to reach Minor Flood Stage.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Alafia River at Lithia .

* WHEN...From this evening to late Saturday night.

* IMPACTS...At 13.0 feet, River Drive and Squirrel Run Way downstream
of County Road 640 are completely covered by water. One home begins
to flood.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:00 AM EDT Thursday the stage was 10.7 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 13.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage early
tomorrow afternoon to a crest of 13.3 feet early Saturday
morning. It will then fall below flood stage late Saturday
evening.
- Flood stage is 13.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 13.3
feet on 08/26/1945.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
